sportswear identity should read through covered track jacket, training pants, sneakers, stopwatch or training band, and running-track or gym context; do not collapse the role into an archive scholar
keep the athletic read practical and nonsexualized; action may be poised, mid-start, or controlled, not body-first fitness glamour

wizard identity should be constructed as medium plus scale plus transformation plus cost or trace; the spell should visibly use the role's own tool, document, screen, seal, mirror, gift, stopwatch, or material surface rather than defaulting to a generic spell circle

unless the user explicitly asks for sci-fi, robot, android, cyborg, data-ghost, alien, or machine-interface magic, do not add visible tech visors, antenna headsets, sensor bands, status LED badges, maintenance QR wristbands, data-port collars, lidar scan dots, machine-vision camera views, robot diagnostics, lens-array focus, exposed-joint focus, boot-flicker motion, cable-fiber textures, liquid-metal textures, synthetic-skin textures, brushed-alloy robot textures, or AR hologram UI as the main spell evidence
distinct from stage magician: no playing-card fan, tailcoat, top hat, audience performance, or sleight-of-hand stagecraft should dominate the image
avoid routine glowing magic circles, generic blue aura, standard fantasy robes, and default old-book-and-candle staging unless the selected bundle explicitly asks for scholarly archive magic

the world response should be specific, local, and visible at thumbnail scale: refraction at a contact point, textless marks lifting above the surface, a few-centimeter levitation shadow, suspended dust or snow, a screen pulse, or a material boundary changing state while the role outfit stays readable

the active spell should visibly change matter or force in the photographed space, not only display symbols: paper chars, ink climbs uphill, frost grows, wax melts and resolidifies, thread tightens, salt vibrates, dust is displaced, crystals grow, candle flames bend, air ripples, or a real object levitates with a cast shadow

for role-wizard bundles, the magic evidence should be the second-strongest visual read after the role tool or costume; avoid relying only on tiny decorative glows, flat in-plane marks, or monochrome lighting when the spell depends on luminous detail
after the latest wizard image reviews, prefer the causal chain tool -> material response -> residue: a viewer should see what caused the spell, what changed physically, and what trace or cost remains
expand wizardry beyond glow or magic circles into practical craft, bureaucracy, scientific thaumaturgy, domestic warding, urban folk rituals, scale paradoxes, and aftermath/cost evidence

when the role is modern or ordinary, strengthen the physical proof rather than adding fantasy costume: wax cooling, paper charring, ink climbing, condensation forming, thread tightening, salt vibrating, dust displaced, frost growing, or air rippling
the covered sportswear stays readable through track jacket, training pants, sneakers, stopwatch, and running-track context, while timing and motion become the spell medium

wizardness should read as kinetic magic: the stopwatch face, training band, or arm gesture bends lane dust and the air around the motion trail, with a subtle gravity lean in nearby markers, not robes, spell circles, books, generic aura, AR UI, or visor
